the last few years have not been easy. i put on even more weight. i am statistically obese. i have gained 80 pounds since high school. still suffering from mental health issues but it’s getting better. i stopped caring what other people think. it’s my body. it’s my choices.

that being said, it’s my choice to lose weight again. to eat healthier and exercise. and i know i will get shit for it. for being the fat girl at a gym or eating salad in public. it doesn’t matter to me anymore. i’m doing this for myself.
